description: Subdivision of Unit 3 into two units with new fire exit and changes to cladding and trim.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2112/01, 2112/02 and Design and Access Statement [received 11/11/2020], and 2112/03(Rev.A) [received 18/12/2020]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby approved shall match existing, unless indicated otherwise on the approved drawings/information.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved cycle storage details, with the approved facilities fully implemented before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied and thereafter retained as such. Further guidance on appropriate dimensions, layouts, and stands is available in the West London Cycle Parking Guidance.
